retrievalProfile.description: A dual-layered urban scene featuring a solitary figure against a graffiti-covered brick wall in the foreground, contrasting with a chaotic, crowded paparazzi scene in the background.
excludeWhen: a clean minimalist aesthetic is required
the scene should be peaceful or empty

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, illustrative composition divided by a red brick wall. The foreground shows a seated, tattooed man in dark clothing against a wall with dripping black spray-paint graffiti. The background depicts a dense, colorful crowd of photographers and media personnel under a hazy urban sky with a helicopter.
coreVisualRelationships: Textural contrast between rough brick and smooth digital figures
Horizontal division created by the brick wall
Color saturation shift from muted foreground to vibrant background
coreInvariants: Red brick wall as a central horizontal divider
Dense crowd of photographers with cameras pointed forward

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is seated in the bottom right foreground; secondary crowd occupies the top half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal line of the brick wall and the dark, seated figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the seated figure, moves left across the graffiti, then jumps over the wall to the dense crowd and up to the helicopter.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with detail, using the brick texture as a grounding element.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright blues and yellows in the background crowd and sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant green and blue trash in the bottom left corner.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background crowd creates depth; foreground is grounded in darker values and earthy tones.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width suggesting a wide-nozzle cap
characterSpecificRedesigns: Accented characters with thick, expressive marks
Underlining with a single, fast spray stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive tag style paired with small, incidental handwritten signs in the background.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the street-art aesthetic of the brick wall.
Provides the necessary weight and variable stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an urban scene with a red brick wall in the foreground. A man with tattoos sits against the wall. Behind the wall, a dense crowd of paparazzi with cameras and a city skyline with a helicopter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom black spray-paint lettering with vertical drips onto the brick wall area, ensuring the texture of the bricks shows through the paint.

verificationChecks: Does the text have realistic paint drips?
Is the wall texture visible through the lettering?
Is there a clear separation between the foreground and the crowd?

adjustableVariables: Time of day (lighting in the sky)
mustRedesign: Existing brand logos on cameras or clothing
Specific text content from the original
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the helicopter is integrated into the sky naturally.
Check that the tattoos on the subject look like skin art, not overlays.
Verify the brick wall has a consistent perspective.
Confirm the graffiti drips follow gravity vertically.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Solitary Figure] + [Textured Divider/Wall] + [Chaotic Background Crowd] using [Street Art Illustration Style].
